name: China CPI (index)
description: The national all-items consumer price index as the International Monetary Fund publishes it (dataflow IMF.STA:CPI). The Fund labels its reference period 2020A.

migration.note: The national all-items index as the Fund publishes it, on the 2020 base where v1's (OECD) was on 2015: over the 322 months both hold, v1's figure is 1.1155 times the Fund's throughout, and the twelve-month changes agree to 0.001 of a point (compared in memory on 2026-11-11; nothing was kept).
